source.author: verg
source.text: Illam Terra parens, ira irritata deorum, extremam ut perhibent Coeo Enceladoque sororem progenuit, pedibus celerem et pernicibus alis, monstrum horrendum, ingens, cui, quot sunt corpore plumae tot vigiles oculi subter, mirabile dictu, tot linguae, totidem ora sonant, tot subrigit aures.
source.text_original: Illam Terra parens, ira irritata deorum, / extremam (ut perhibent) Coeo Enceladoque sororem / progenuit, pedibus celerem et pernicibus alis, / monstrum horrendum, ingens, cui, quot sunt corpore plumae / tot vigiles oculi subter, mirabile dictu, / tot linguae, totidem ora sonant, tot subrigit aures.
source.text_english: Mother Earth, angered by the wrath of the gods, gave birth, as they say, to that last sister of Coeus and Enceladus, swift of foot and with nimble wings: a monstrous, dreadful thing, huge, with as many feathers on her body as there are watchful eyes beneath, a marvelous thing to tell, as many tongues, as many ringing mouths, and as many ears pricked up.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: ego puto in id ipsum significari et horrendum non, ut uulgus existimat, despiciendum et squalidum secundum illud: mihi frigidus horror membra quatit et: horror ubique animo, simul ipsa silentia terrent et: monstrum horrendum, ingens et multa his similia.
reuse.text_original: ego puto in id ipsum significari et 'horrendum' — non, ut uulgus existimat, despiciendum et squalidum — secundum illud: mihi frigidus horror membra quatit et: horror ubique animo, simul ipsa silentia terrent et: monstrum horrendum, ingens et multa his similia.
reuse.text_english: I think that this very thing is meant by the word horrendum, and that it is not, as the common people think, something to be despised and filthy, according to the lines: a cold horror shakes my limbs, and: horror is everywhere in my mind; at the same time the very silences frighten me, and: a monstrous thing, dreadful, huge, and many others like these.
